extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism ontology from local XML/PDF sections, figures, and SPR/proteolysis tables; mechanism strength is bounded to direct assays and genetic-support evidence present in the article.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: RUFI targets the mycobacterial ClpC1 proteostasis pathway and directly inhibits ClpC1/P1/P2 proteolytic degradation of FITC-casein, while showing only a mild and insignificant effect on ClpC1 ATPase activity.
mechanism_claims.limitations: The final artifact does not infer exact figure datapoints from the image; it preserves the text/caption-supported mechanism direction and reported significance.

mechanism_claims.entity_scope: RUFI, ECU, and CYMA binding to mycobacterial ClpC1
mechanism_claims.claim_text: SPR assays support binding of RUFI to full-length mycobacterial ClpC1, with Table 5 reporting kinetic affinity values for M. tuberculosis, M. abscessus, and M. chelonae ClpC1.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Binding affinity supports target engagement but is not by itself a full downstream mechanism claim.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Spontaneously generated RUFI-resistant M. tuberculosis mutants carried single substitutions in the N-terminal domain of ClpC1, supporting ClpC1 target involvement and a binding pattern distinct from ECU.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Genetic resistance supports target association and does not replace the direct proteolysis/binding assays.
